title: HAVE THE VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS LOST CONFIDENCE? A STUDY OF SYCOPHANCY IN VLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the MM-SY benchmark by measuring the sycophancy rate, which is the proportion of times a vision-language model changes its initially correct answer to blindly agree with a user's deliberately incorrect modification request across different dialogue tones (suggestive, euphemistic, strong).
